sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the DIRECT_STATIC table-selection logic and comparison boundary. The required-rank expression is incorrect for steelMaterialClassTwo: for thickness >10 and <=15 with PC6–7 it must select rank 1, not rank 2; for thickness >35 and <=40 with PC1–5 it must select rank 3, not rank 2. Also constrain each actualHullStructuralSteelGrade value to have exactly one nltl:steelGradeOrderRank with xsd:integer datatype (the current query joins the rank, so a missing rank produces no solution and can accidentally pass). Preserve the conditional absence of requiredHullStructuralSteelGrade only for the declared NOT_APPLICABLE combinations, and retain the existing case-owner paths and selector cardinalities.
